subject.title: fix(state): surface worker request failures without cloning consumed bodies and retry transient 5xx

question: Should transient retries apply unconditionally to all signed Worker requests, including operations that may mutate durable worker state?
rationale: The correct scope depends on the Worker API's idempotency contract; source-level retry tests cannot establish whether a timeout or 5xx happened before or after a write took effect.

options.title: Scope retries to idempotent requests
options.body: Retry only read-safe or explicitly idempotent Worker operations, or require an operation idempotency key for retried writes.

options.title: Accept universal retry semantics
options.body: Keep the shared retry behavior only if maintainers confirm every affected signed write is safely repeatable after an ambiguous failure.

recommendation.title: Scope retries to idempotent requests
recommendation.body: Retry only read-safe or explicitly idempotent Worker operations, or require an operation idempotency key for retried writes.
